title: The End of Rapid Iteration
summary: Why acceleration is becoming the new competitive advantage.
coverAlt: Two conceptual charts compare development speed over time with irregular fluctuations: blue maintains a higher speed on the left; on the right, blue accelerates above red from the same starting point despite local setbacks.
coverCaption: Conceptual illustration, not measured data. Left: a higher development speed despite day-to-day fluctuations. Right: the development system also improves, allowing the speed advantage to grow. Development speed means validated progress per unit of time.

title: KV Caching Across Accelerators on Edge SoCs
summary: What a KV cache saves, when another engine can use it, and when rebuilding the context is the better option.
coverAlt: A growing video history branches into independent answers, each bound to its own completed prefix; pending frames remain outside those views.
coverCaption: New frames extend the history. Each answer keeps the completed prefix it started with.

title: What We Learned the Hard Way About NPUs, GPUs, and Unified Memory
summary: NPUs like stable graphs, GPUs need enough parallel work, and shared memory is still shared.
coverAlt: CPU, GPU, and NPU connected to one shared memory pool
coverCaption: Different execution models. One shared memory system.
